profile.summary: CaliFitness Equipment Services is a company based in Fresno, California, that repairs and maintains gym equipment. It also installs and relocates equipment, rents and sells new and refurbished equipment, and offers preventive maintenance programs. It serves customers in the Central Valley and other parts of California.
